question: rewards an ally dying (event)
query: select card from flat_when where event='dies' and obj_side='mine' and coalesce(obj_pick,'')!='self'

question: cares whether allies died (condition)
query: select card from flat_if where event='dies'

question: triggers when you play a spell
query: select card from flat_when where event in ('played','spell_resolves') and actor_side='mine' and (obj_kind='spell' or obj_with like '%spell%')

question: triggers when you summon an ally
query: select card from flat_when where event='summoned' and coalesce(obj_pick,'')!='self' and (actor_side='mine' or obj_side='mine')

question: kills own units
query: select card from flat_do where act='kill' and on_side='mine'

question: stuns
query: select card from flat_do where act='stun' or (act='cant' and param_event='attacks' and lasts='this_round' and on_side in ('enemy','any'))

question: frostbites (power to 0)
query: select card from flat_do where act='stat_set' and params like '%power=0%'

question: recalls units or cares about recalling
query: select card from flat_do where act='return_to_hand' union select card from flat_when where event='recalled' union select card from flat_if where event='recalled'

question: draws cards
query: select card from flat_do where act='draw'

question: creates cards
query: select card from flat_do where act in ('create','copy','choose_card') or (act='keyword_action' and keyword_ref in (select id from card where name in ('Invoke','Manifest','Reforge')))

question: damages the enemy Nexus
expected: text:\b(?:deal|deals) \d+ to (?:the enemy nexus|each player's nexus|both nexuses|all enemies and the enemy nexus|an enemy or the enemy nexus|anything|the enemy nexus and)
query: select card from flat_do where act in ('damage','excess_damage') and on_kind in ('player','any')

question: heals
query: select card from flat_do where act='heal'

question: discards
query: select card from flat_do where act='discard'

question: obliterates
query: select card from flat_do where act='obliterate'

question: levels up (champion level-up condition)
query: select card from flat_do where act='level_up'

question: grants lasting stats
query: select card from flat_do where act='stat_change' and lasts in ('permanent','while','while_attached','unstated')

question: gives Barrier (damage prevention)
query: select card from flat_do where act='negate_damage' and origin='uses_keyword'

question: Nexus Strike triggers
query: select card from flat_when where event='strikes_nexus'

question: Last Breath (dies) triggers
query: select card from flat_when where event='dies' and obj_pick='self'

question: Round Start triggers
query: select card from flat_when where event='round_start'

question: Round End triggers
query: select card from flat_when where event='round_end'

question: Attack triggers
query: select card from flat_when where event='attacks'

question: Overwhelm units deal excess damage
query: select card from flat_do where act='excess_damage'

question: Elusive units can't be blocked by most units
query: select card from flat_do where act='cant' and param_event='blocks'

question: Ephemeral units die at round end
query: select w.card from flat_when w join flat_do d on d.ability=w.ability and d.card=w.card where w.event in ('round_end','strikes') and d.act='kill'

question: Plunder: needs damage to the enemy Nexus this round
query: select card from flat_if where event='nexus_damaged'

question: Countdown landmarks
query: select card from flat_when where event='countdown_done'

question: refills/gains mana or cares about refilling
query: select card from flat_do where act in ('mana_gain','max_mana_change') union select card from flat_when where event='mana_refilled'

question: Toss (obliterate own deck)
query: select card from flat_do where act='obliterate' and on_side='mine' and on_zone in ('deck','deck_bottom')

question: Rally (attack token)
query: select card from flat_do where act='gain_attack_token'

question: Predict
query: select card from flat_do where act='choose_card' and origin='uses_keyword'

question: reduces costs
query: select card from flat_do where act in ('cost_change','cost_set')

question: copies cards or spells (incl. becoming an exact copy)
query: select card from flat_do where act in ('copy','repeat','revive') or (act='transform' and card_ref is null)

question: Behold (have a card)
query: select card from flat_if where test='have'

question: Daybreak / Nightfall
query: select card from flat_if where test='first_card'

question: can't block
query: select card from flat_do where act='cant' and param_event='blocks'

question: summons units or cares about summoning
query: select card from flat_do where act in ('summon','revive','copy','play_card') union select card from flat_when where event='summoned' and coalesce(obj_pick,'')!='self' union select card from flat_if where event='summoned'

question: revives
query: select card from flat_do where act='revive'

question: silences
query: select card from flat_do where act='silence'

question: shuffles cards into a deck
expected: text:\bshuffle\b(?! (?:my|its|their) stats)|\binto (?:your|the enemy|their|its player's) deck\b|\bplace (?:it|that unit|them|me|the rest) into\b
query: select card from flat_do where act in ('shuffle_into_deck','put_on_top') or (eff_zone in ('deck','deck_top','deck_bottom') and act in ('create','copy','move','summon'))

question: triggers when you draw
query: select card from flat_when where event='drawn'

question: When I'm summoned triggers
query: select card from flat_when where event='summoned' and obj_pick='self'

question: Strike triggers
query: select card from flat_when where event='strikes'

question: gives Challenger
query: select card from flat_do where keyword_ref=(select id from card where name='Challenger' and is_keyword=1) or concept='target_choice'

question: gives Elusive
query: select card from flat_do where keyword_ref=(select id from card where name='Elusive' and is_keyword=1)

question: gives Vulnerable
query: select card from flat_do where keyword_ref=(select id from card where name='Vulnerable' and is_keyword=1) union select card from flat_when where obj_with like '%keyword is '||(select id from card where name='Vulnerable' and is_keyword=1)||'%' union select card from card_keyword where keyword=(select id from card where name='Vulnerable' and is_keyword=1)

question: Lifesteal units heal their Nexus
query: select card from flat_concept where concept='lifesteal'

question: Regeneration units heal fully
query: select card from flat_concept where concept='regeneration'

question: Tough units take less damage
query: select card from flat_do where act='damage_reduction'

question: Fearsome units evade weak blockers
query: select card from flat_concept where concept='evasion'

question: Quick Attack strikes first
query: select card from flat_do where act='first_strike'

question: SpellShield negates enemy spells
query: select card from flat_do where act='counter'

question: Spirit / Gloom / Impact stacking keywords
query: select card from flat_concept where concept='stacking_keyword'

question: damage equal to a stat or count
query: select card from flat_do where act='damage' and params like '%amount=None%'

question: effects scaling with a count (for each)
query: select card from flat_if where test like 'amount_%' union select card from flat_do where params like '%=None%'

question: temporary buffs this round
query: select card from flat_do where act='stat_change' and lasts='this_round'

question: Invoke (does it or cares about it)
query: select card from flat_do where keyword_ref=(select id from card where name='Invoke' and is_keyword=1) union select card from flat_when where event='keyword_used' and obj_with like '%keyword is '||(select id from card where name='Invoke' and is_keyword=1)||'%'

question: Manifest
query: select card from flat_do where keyword_ref=(select id from card where name='Manifest' and is_keyword=1)

question: Plants traps or Puffcaps
query: select card from flat_concept where concept='trap_secret'

question: Imbue (when a spell resolves)
query: select card from flat_when where event in ('spell_resolves','played') and (obj_kind='spell' or obj_with like '%spell%')

question: Spawn
query: select card from flat_do where keyword_ref=(select id from card where name='Spawn' and is_keyword=1)

question: Equipment attaches
query: select card from flat_do where act='attach'

question: Augment grows on created cards
query: select card from flat_when where event='played' and obj_with like '%created%'

question: Formidable strikes with Health
query: select card from flat_do where act='strike_with'

question: Reputation
query: select card from flat_if where test='keyword_condition' or test='event_count' and event='strikes'

question: Allegiance
query: select card from flat_if where test='have' and of_zone='deck_top'

question: Enlightened
query: select card from flat_if where test='max_mana'

question: Empowered
query: select card from flat_if where test='stat' and op='ge'

question: Fury grows on kills
query: select card from flat_when where event='killed' and actor_pick='self'

question: transforms
query: select card from flat_do where act='transform' union select card from flat_when where event='transformed'

question: Capture
query: select card from flat_do where act='capture' or on_zone='removed' union select card from flat_if where of_zone='removed'

question: Deathless / cheat death
query: select card from flat_concept where concept='cheat_death'

question: Nab
query: select card from flat_do where keyword_ref=(select id from card where name='Nab' and is_keyword=1)

question: Flow
query: select card from flat_if where event='played' and span='last_round'

question: Support
query: select card from flat_do where on_pick='right_of_self' union select card from flat_when where event='supports'

question: Attune refills spell mana
query: select card from flat_do where act='mana_gain' and on_kind='spell_mana'

question: Scout attacks again
query: select card from flat_concept where concept='multi_attack'

question: Fleeting cards are discarded at round end
query: select card from flat_when where event='round_end' and card in (select card from flat_do where act='discard' and on_pick='self')

question: Advance (Countdowns)
query: select card from flat_do where act='countdown_advance' or keyword_ref=(select id from card where name='Advance' and is_keyword=1)

question: counters spells
query: select card from flat_do where act='counter'
